first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is also declining, so simplifying onboarding directly addresses both current bottlenecks. The inherited evidence supports durable gains in activation and time-to-value, but completion improvements may not translate into qualified revenue; therefore the experiment should track activation, qualified pipeline, retention, and revenue quality rather than completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a guarded SMB-only onboarding simplification test, since the current declines in onboarding completion and activation are directly addressed by the verified evidence. Signup simplification previously lifted activation 9% and qualified revenue 4%, while shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and retention. The signup change also reduced 30-day retention by 1% and did not replicate beyond SMB, so use a holdout and monitor qualified revenue, retention, activation quality, and time-to-value before scaling.
